_comment: Deploy-time settings that Claude Design does not hold. Read by build.py, forms-overlay.js (through build.py) and verify.py.
address: the postal address required by the Google Ad Grants policy. Shown on /contact/ and in the footer of every page. Empty = verify gate (m) fails on purpose.
formEndpoint: URL that receives the contact, press and open-letter forms. Empty = those forms open the visitor's email app, addressed to contactEmail.
disabledLanguages: languages hidden from the selector, hreflang and og:locale. Their translations stay published, so removing a code turns it back on.
address: everyone.AI, 1259 El Camino Real, Unit #1042, Menlo Park, CA 94025
